name: InsertRowIntoDataTableNode
label: Insert Row Into Data Table
description: Inserts a new row into the data table at the specified location.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to which the new row will be added.

fields.name: RowValues
fields.label: Row Values
fields.description: An array of values to insert into the new row. Must match column count and types. Example: For columns [Id, Name, Age], use [1, 'John', 30]

fields.name: InsertLocation
fields.label: Insert Location
fields.description: Specifies whether to insert the row at the end or before a specific index.

selectOptions.label: Before Row Index
selectOptions.description: Insert row before a specific index.

fields.name: RowIndex
fields.label: Row Index
fields.description: Zero-based index before which to insert the row (used only when location is 'Before Row Index').

fields.name: ModifiedDataTable
fields.label: Modified Data Table
fields.description: The updated data table with the new row inserted.
